item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02555","case1_error":"Correct cost and sharing formulas are followed by unsupported numbers; none equals the correct $25 share.","case2_error":"Uses one-gallon capacity for all paint, ignoring the three-gallon white cans; needs 10 cans.","reason":"Case 1 supplies unsupported numbers after correct formulas; case 2 explicitly uses an incorrect conversion relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02556","case1_error":"Mislabels salary minus necessities as expenses and ignores the stated $18 remainder, reporting $38 instead of $20 taxes.","case2_error":"Explicitly instructs subtracting the $400 repair expense twice, then supplies an unsupported final $1100.","reason":"Case 1 omits the given remainder through incorrect expense relations; case 2 duplicates a deduction and gives an unexplained final number.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02557","case1_error":"Replaces O = 0.25T with O = 0.25(T − 72), then incorrectly concludes O = 2 from O = 0.25O.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 476 − 75 as 391 instead of 401.","reason":"Case 1 changes the percentage relation and makes an invalid algebraic inference; case 2 makes a numerical evaluation error in a correct expression.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02558","case1_error":"Treats Frank's sold third, 12 apples, as his remaining apples instead of subtracting it from 36.","case2_error":"Includes only one initial group of four bottles, omitting the other from the total.","reason":"Case 1 confuses the removed portion with the remainder; case 2 omits an additive quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02559","case1_error":"Omits Saturday's additional 10 rounds, counting only the initial round and Sunday's rounds.","case2_error":"Omits the $2 Sunday newspaper expense from each week's spending.","reason":"Both omit an explicitly stated additive contribution while correctly calculating the included quantities.","judgment":"same"}]}
